name: Zor Lonetree
summary: At Grommash Hold, Zor Lonetree studies the Horde’s concerns beyond Durotar. His knowledge of Alliance politics helps the court judge foreign affairs across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Advisor in Grommash Hold
sections.body: Zor Lonetree watches beyond Durotar from Grommash Hold. A shrewd advisor to the Horde’s high leadership, he has an unusually keen understanding of human and Alliance politics. When foreign curiosities reach Orgrimmar, he studies them; when trouble stirs among the land’s spirits, he directs travelers toward it. He has examined noble jewelry recovered from human settlements and followed disturbances among the spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains, keeping the warchief’s court informed on both political and spiritual matters.

faq.answer: Zor Lonetree advises the Horde from inside Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar. His keen grasp of Alliance politics and interest in Kalimdor’s spiritual matters make him a useful counselor.

faq.q: Where can I find Zor Lonetree?
faq.answer: You can find Zor Lonetree inside Grommash Hold, in the Valley of Wisdom at the heart of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What tasks does Zor Lonetree give adventurers?
faq.answer: Zor Lonetree sends Horde champions to aid the spirits of Stonetalon Peak and soothe elemental unrest in the Stonetalon Mountains. He also analyzes strange human relics that scouts bring to the capital.

faq.q: Why is Zor Lonetree knowledgeable about the Alliance?
aliases: why does zor know alliance politics
faq.answer: Zor Lonetree specializes in foreign affairs and statecraft. He studies human aristocratic customs and Alliance movements, helping him read noble signets, regalia, and tactical motives that other orcs might overlook.

angles.text: As a Horde scout near human enclaves or disputed borders, you can turn to Zor Lonetree in Orgrimmar to interpret enemy intentions and relics.
As a shaman answering disturbed elemental forces, you share common cause with Zor Lonetree, who watches the suffering spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains.
